description: The extensibility case (P7-S2): a different specialty, a different payer, a different plan type, and a policy whose central requirement is a judgement rather than a threshold. VNS Health Plans requires that the member 'demonstrates meaningful functional progress' for a continuation authorization, which cannot be keyword-matched - the note carries a table of objective measures across four re-assessments and the matcher has to read improvement out of it. Three criteria are exclusions with polarity absent (maintenance-only care, duplicative therapists, no measurable improvement after 4-6 visits), so a well-documented member must read as satisfying them. The pack and the note are data: no code in src/attest changes to run this case.
